sources.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 through web retrieval after the direct-cache request returned HTTP 403. Sol and Luna were trained with similar methods to Astra; this is not an explicit derivation from a counted base. The launch comparisons report scores, cost and latency, with no nominal total or active parameter count.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol API model reference
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 through the official documentation tool; the cached Markdown also returned HTTP 200 at 16:22 UTC. Exact gpt-6-sol reference specifies 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens, text/image input, reasoning and tools including the Chat Completions none-effort exception. It supplies no nominal total or active parameter count; API limits and pricing units are not model size.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: September 22 explicitly releases gpt-6-sol. September 25 fixes image encoding in the API and Codex. The September 29 GPT-6.1 Sol launch names a separate model; neither update changes the original release date.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card — Appendix A: GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna
sources.evidence: Reopened the original PDF and searched its full text; fetched HTTP 200 on October 27 at 15:42 UTC. Appendix A.1 says Sol and Luna use the same types of data and training as Astra; it does not identify a counted base or give nominal sizes. Appendix A comparison tables and A.7 monitorability sections report behavioral scores and CoT examples. Full-text parameter/activated/size/structural searches revealed no total or active count.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.evidence: Re-read the September 29 original PDF fetched HTTP 200 on October 27 at 15:42 UTC. Section 2 describes types of data/training and cautions that older-model comparison values may reflect later versions. Exact Sol columns in Tables 10/11 contain CoT examples and Table 12 contains biological evaluation scores; no nominal total or active-parameter column was found.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: Re-read the October 26 original PDF fetched HTTP 200 on October 27 at 15:42 UTC. Section 2 gives training-type context, not counted-base lineage. The exact gpt-6-sol HealthBench column reports length-adjusted scores, unadjusted scores and mean response characters; later Sol comparisons concern alignment/monitorability. No nominal total or active count was found.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna: October 2026 update
sources.evidence: Re-read the October 7 original PDF fetched HTTP 200 on October 27 at 15:42 UTC. It explicitly distinguishes October ChatGPT variants from September versions retained in Work/Codex. Training and comparison sections provide no nominal total or active count; the additional safety training is not a link to any base with a published size.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses and Chat Completions support PDF inputs. Vision-capable models receive extracted text and page images; with exact Sol vision support, this establishes PDF as an API document format, not a separate native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service/API access while reserving service intellectual property. Combined with hosted model distribution, supports a descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide describes reusable key/value states and supports GPT-6 caching. It does not specify Sol production topology or numerical parameters; KV terminology alone is insufficient to establish a Transformer or MoE classification.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived article explains Transformer attention but explicitly applies only to models before GPT-5.6. Its structural explanation is not transferred to GPT-6 Sol.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact gpt-6-sol mentions are replacement recommendations for older models; no shutdown entry for Sol was found. This is documentation review, not a live endpoint test.

sources.title: OpenAI EU AI Act resources
sources.evidence: Reopened the current directory October 27. It lists a GPT-6 Astra training-content summary but no exact GPT-6 Sol summary. The listed sibling summary was also read as s15; its data-volume ranges do not establish a Sol parameter count.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-6 Sol record
sources.evidence: The original catalog lead was accessed through its raw file. Its release date, context and capabilities were independently checked against primary documentation; its cross-generation gpt-sol grouping is corrected.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-6 Astra
sources.evidence: Original v1 summary, dated September 2, freshly fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC and read for this pass. Identifies only GPT-6 Astra, says it is not a modification/fine-tune of a prior model, and gives training-data ranges (including more than 10 trillion text tokens). Those are neither model parameters nor an exact Sol lineage disclosure.

family.note: GPT-6 is the generation; Sol identifies its tier. Correct the cross-generation gpt-sol grouping.

release_date.note: Explicit API/public release; subsequent encoding fix, successor and October ChatGPT variant are separate events.

open_weights.note: Reviewed distribution is hosted service/API access, with no Sol checkpoint or weight redistribution license offered.

license.note: Descriptive classification under hosted service terms, not a downloadable-weight or SPDX license.

parameters_b.note: October 27 parameter-only re-audit found no published nominal total after reopening the original launch, Sol appendix, exact API reference, later Sol/Terra and October cards, and training-summary material. Fresh exact-name searches for parameter counts, billion/trillion sizes and technical comparisons found no supported count. Shared training methods with Astra do not establish a counted-base lineage; training-data quantities, prices and behavioral capacity are not literal parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: October 27 separate active-count recheck found no nominal active figure. Later original model-team comparisons were checked explicitly: GPT-6.1 Sol Table 12 gives biological scores and GPT-6.1 Terra HealthBench gives scores/response lengths, with no active-parameter column. Bounded exact-name active/activated-parameter searches, including original-paper/model-card leads, found no qualifying count. No dense=active or sibling-size inference is made.

architecture.note: The checked original/later training and monitoring material does not establish production Transformer, dense or MoE topology. Similar training methods are not shared architecture; the older Transformer caching explanation excludes this generation.

context_window.note: Documented API limit, with explicit 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. Only the undated identifier is listed.

modalities.note: Text/image are native inputs; PDF is an API file format processed into text and page images. Image-generation tool access is not native image output.

reasoning.note: Supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max. An optional none setting does not negate reasoning support.

tool_call.note: Responses supports tools with reasoning. Chat Completions function calling is supported only with reasoning_effort=none; do not transfer Astra restrictions.

description.note: Retain the factual description supported by the exact model reference and launch.

patch.notes: Public/API release was September 22, 2026. The API reference lists only the undated gpt-6-sol identifier: 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 output. Reasoning defaults to medium and supports none through max. Responses supports reasoning with tools; Chat Completions function calling requires reasoning_effort=none. PDF is converted to text and page images. September 25 corrected image encoding; October 7 introduced a distinct ChatGPT version, while Work and Codex retained September versions. Those events do not establish an identical or replacement production API checkpoint. Nominal total and active parameters remain undisclosed; shared training methods with Astra do not establish a counted base, and later exact Sol comparisons report performance rather than parameter counts. Production architecture remains unverified. No exact Sol API shutdown notice was found; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after reopening the original launch, API reference, full Sol appendix, later Sol/Terra and October comparison cards, and training summaries. No supported nominal count or counted-base lineage was found. Explicit parameter patch values and parameters_source are null; the other 12 field assessments and their supported family/license corrections are preserved.
